supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Moderate extension beyond the lateral canthus of the eyes.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Muzzle exhibits high pixel intensity (light grey/tan) in contrast to the low-intensity (dark/black) periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick lower lip with a pronounced structural droop and visible pink mucosa.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white/grey grizzling localized on the lower chin and perimeter of the muzzle.
